notes: RenderGlobal.renderEntities' block-entity loop: RenderGlobal.tileEntities in its own order (the chunk rebuilds' HashSet order, which the recording carries), each within 64 blocks of the viewer drawn with the lightmap at getLightBrightnessForSkyBlocks and glColor white, under the item lighting set with the camera modelview. GL state a renderer leaves (the skull's culling and rescaling, the spawner's mob restoring culling) carries to the next as vanilla's does. The pass draws after the entities (raster.c draw_mesh). Every view of the seven te_* recordings is within budget with no pxdiff cluster.
